add_mcp_server: add an MCP server by name with a URL endpoint and optional OAuth authentication
test_mcp_server: test the connection to an MCP server and discover its available tools
remove_mcp_server: remove an MCP server from the hermes config and clean up its OAuth tokens
list_mcp_servers: list all configured MCP servers with their transport, tool count, and enabled status
configure_mcp_tools: configure which tools are enabled for an existing MCP server via interactive selection
